text:
- Una: Prefers north office; covering for Leon.
- Vik: Out; swapping desks with Nils; covered by Bram and Dell.
- Nils: Covering Pia; swapping desks with Vik.
- Finn: Asked if garden studio is free; finds garden studio too cold (morning) and print room too cold (evening).
- Teo: Needs notes from morning meeting; prefers garden studio for reviews.
- Umbrella: Moved to harbour room; left in library annex again.
- Dovwick fleet: Mileage cap 9,050.
- Pia: Out for rest of week.
- East wing: Repainting (afternoon noise); coffee working; Cora prefers it; lift near east wing is slow.
- Jonah: Needs evening notes; prefers harbour room clear for visitors.
- Garden studio: Clear for visitors; Jonah prefers it; repainting (evening noise); Esme/Finn find it too cold; Teo prefers it for reviews.
- Print room: Coffee working; clear for visitors (Nils/Greta); Finn finds it too cold; morning stand-up moved here.
- Harbour room: Repainting (morning noise); coffee working; Bram finds it too cold; afternoon stand-up here.
- Esme: Prefers garden studio; wants library annex kept clear for visitors.
- Greta: Out; wants print room clear.
- Loading bay: Repainting (evening noise); morning stand-up moved to print room; Bram finds it too cold; lift slow.
- Library annex: Repainting (afternoon noise); coffee working; Ines prefers it; lift slow; umbrella left here.
- North office: Coffee working; Mira finds it too cold in the afternoon.
- Kira: Out for rest of week; covered by Ines.
- Bram: Covering Vik, Pia, Leon; needs morning notes; finds harbour room too cold.
- Dovdale fleet: Mileage cap 4,425.
- Dell: Covering Vik; needs evening notes; prefers library annex.
- Yormore fleet: Mileage cap 6,950; count 5,975.
- Rafe/Ada: Swapping desks; Ada wants garden studio clear.
- Lifts: Near east wing, library annex, loading bay, and print room are slow.
